notes.title: 【iFVN】V1.2.4.0916 Update Log
notes.content:
[i]Previous project update method:
If you have any problems, please feel free to contact us at xb@cedong.com.cn 
[/i]


[h2]Software[/h2]
[h3]New or adjusted features:[/h3]

1. Now you can play music in resource part.
2. Now you can pause the music playing.
3. Now the script can be automatic updated (Menu - Project - Project preferences)
4. Adjust some display function of the Asset Store
5. Now you can change your iFAction AVG project into iFVN ([i] *This operation can not be undone, it is strongly recommended to back up your project before upgrading! [/i])
6. Fix the bug of wrong coordinates when selecting the center coordinate for the picture
7. Now the project has the backup once a day.  (The backup folder is under the project directory)
8. Add project preferences (Menu - Project - preferences)
9. Optimized the problem of software jamming after long time use (if you still find jamming, please inform us)


>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
[h2]Game Display[/h2]
(* the previous project bug can only be repaired after the default script is restored in the tool. For specific tutorials, [url=http://bbs.cedong.com.cn/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=8&extra=page%3D1][u]click here to see[/u][/url])

1. Fixed the Bug that iFVN could not save the animation being played
2. Fixed the Bug that may cause saving dislocation when opening the interface
3. Fixed the Bug that text box can not disappear when calling the custom interface
4. Fixed the Bug of error reporting when opening the inquiry box by calling custom interface


>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
